repos_data.description: 📊 The best API for Web Automation, Testing, and Scraping. CDP Mode launches a stealth browser that bypasses bot-detection/CAPTCHAs. Adds stealth to Playwright. Includes an MCP server for AI agents.
Stealth browser for AI agents — real Chrome over raw CDP, no Playwright/Puppeteer. TypeScript + MCP-native. Passes sannysoft 57/57, bypasses Cloudflare.

Stealth browser automation for AI agents — unattended, headless, N parallel persistent logged-in Chromes. One MCP server + CLI, credential vault with TOTP/IMAP 2FA, vision clicking, prompt-injection scanning. Self-hosted, real Chrome. 2,027 tests.
